Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Elevated interest rates threaten to add further pressure on Australia’s private credit sector given its weighting to the country’s struggling real estate market, an Ares Management Corp. executive has warned.

Australia’s central bank has raised interest rates four times to 4.6% this year and signaled further tightening may come as it combats inflation. The higher borrowing costs add an extra burden on the country’s private debt market, Peter Graf, partner and head of Asia direct lending at Ares, one of the world’s largest private credit managers, said during the Citi Australia & New Zealand Investment Conference in Sydney on Tuesday.
